name: pin-saver
description: Pinterest board downloader Chrome extension (clean-room implementation)

scripts.test: node --test test/unit.test.js test/integration.test.js test/pdf.test.js test/video.test.js test/api-hardness.test.js test/batch-fetch.test.js test/convert.test.js test/sections.test.js test/export.test.js test/range.test.js test/sort.test.js
scripts.zip: rm -f ../pin-saver-extension.zip && zip -qr ../pin-saver-extension.zip manifest.json src popup icons
scripts.package: npm run check && npm run zip && echo 'built ../pin-saver-extension.zip'
